leadText:
Volume 33: Attack on Celestic is the 33rd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fourth volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume four of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".
plainText:
Volume 33: Attack on Celestic is the 33rd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fourth volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume four of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
Mysteries abound when a Psyduck and a Pokémon Researcher go missing. And Lady fights two epic Gym battles! If only Pearl and Diamond could stop fighting each other...!

Then, what secret does Cyrus, leader of Team Galactic, seek in the ruins and relics of Celestic Town...?

Plus, meet Carnivine, Floatzel, Magnezone, Drifblim, Mismagius, Bronzong and many more Sinnoh Pokémon friends!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 365 - Crafty Carnivine
Chapter 366 - Floatzel and Jetsam
Chapter 367 - Suffering Psyduck
Chapter 368 - Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone I
Chapter 369 - Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone II
Chapter 370 - Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone III
Chapter 371 - Drifting Drifblim
Chapter 372 - Mirages of Mismagius I
Chapter 373 - Mirages of Mismagius II
Chapter 374 - Brash Bronzong I

==Important events==
 
defeats Crasher Wake.
The trio meet Cynthia again at the Pokémon Mansion.
The trio meet Cynthia's grandmother and she tells them the legend of the three lakes of Sinnoh.
Cyrus invades the .
Platinum defeats Fantina.
The trio encounter Platinum's father and Professor Rowan trapped inside a cube in the Canalave Gym.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
No Pokémon are caught in this volume.

===Evolutions===
No Pokémon evolve in this volume.

==Gym battles==
Platinum defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Crasher Wake in PS366
Fantina in PS373
